verified: login idle: blank submit validates locally and issues no identity request
login loading: the single submit control is aria-busy and disabled while the real request is held open
login failure: real 400 (format) and 401 (credential) share one constant message and re-enable retry; account existence is not disclosed
login transport failure: a real aborted request reports service unavailability, never a credential verdict
same-origin and CSRF: cross-origin and origin-less login 403; missing/wrong/foreign-origin CSRF 403; the session-bound token logs out once with 200
entry limiter: request 60 returns 429 with Retry-After and refuses even a valid login; the same login succeeds after the window
account lock: five real failures lock the account server-side; the correct password returns the identical 401 body; the lock expires on the server clock and the same password then issues a session

first password: reload keeps first_password_only with zero business reads; wrong current password 401 keeps the session; mismatch/short password never reach the API; cancel revokes the session; the real change 201 rotates the cookie, the old cookie is 401 and a reload keeps the new session
first-password boundary: business, MFA status and administrator APIs answer 403
self password: wrong current 401, client-side mismatch, real 201 rotation, old cookie 401, reload is a full LoA1 session
logout: the account dialog logout is server-confirmed 200, the old cookie is 401 and a reload stays signed out

MFA enrolment: pending secret shown once; a reload shows the server pending state without the secret; password+TOTP raises the server session to urn:ops:loa:2; confirmation returns ten recovery codes once; reload shows confirmed/10/confirmedAt
MFA binding cancel: no MFA request, pending secret removed, the confirmed factor untouched
MFA wrong credential: a wrong password or wrong TOTP keeps the challenge open and never reports success

MFA natural expiry: a challenge idle for 660s refuses a valid TOTP with a real 409, clears the pending secret and offers a restart; the challenge row is expired with created_at -> idle_expires_at of exactly 600s
MFA re-binding: the confirmed factor proves the step-up, the new secret is confirmed, confirmedAt advances, the state persists after a reload and the replaced factor's recovery codes are refused
administrator MFA reset: target revision/credential binding, 200, real revoked session count, target reset_required with zero codes and a forced security page
recovery code: an unknown code is refused, a real code verifies once, revokes every session, deletes the whole code set and leaves reset_required; the pre-recovery cookie is 401
zero-grant boundary: /settings/permissions and /overview denied, admin users and business resources 403, own MFA status 200
failedOrPreserved: first MFA re-binding attempt submitted the pending secret where the confirmed factor is required (server rule) and was refused; corrected harness passes in runs/rebind.json
an earlier b-row of scripts lost a rotated password because the file was written after a later assertion; the affected identities are preserved and were not reused
the natural-expiry batch kept failing after its assertions on a harness-level dangling waiter; the assertions themselves passed and are recorded

the 15-minute absolute step-up expiry was not waited out (only the 10-minute idle expiry)

items: screenshots: the 17 quarantined mfa-* captures stay quarantined (plus 23 suspicious images moved into the host quarantine at 0700/0600); all nine r30.accept.* factors were reset through the administrator UI so no captured secret can still be used; every capture now goes through harness/safe-capture.mjs, which refuses an image while an otpauth URI, recovery code or one-time code is on screen, and secret-bearing states are recorded as machine-checked assertions only (containment.json, runs/safe-captures.json)
SL-001 visual corrected from the inherited pass to not_verified; the whole table now reports visual passed = 0

the 04 natural-expiry claim about submitting the confirmed factor's correct code is withdrawn (the 409 happened at the password step before any factor was evaluated); the database wording is now '600s from the last activity', not 'exactly 600s from creation'
runs/idle-expiry-confirmed.json proves the idle window (600s, no activity) and then proves the same confirmed factor reaches LoA2 on a fresh challenge
runs/absolute-expiry.json proves the 900s absolute deadline in real wall-clock time with the idle window refreshed by a completed method at t+9min
runs/cross-account-concurrency.json proves challenges, one-time codes and recovery codes cannot be reused across identities or replayed

native-deployment-runbook.md gained the r30 section with roll-forward and recovery boundaries; the remaining SP06 scope is limited to the resource and business tool path because the audit data_query chain already passed in r28

the idle window can only be moved forward up to the absolute cap (idle_expires_at is clamped to absolute_expires_at), so the absolute deadline is the binding limit; both windows were measured separately in real time without touching time or state in SQL

windows.idleExpiry: runs/idle-expiry-confirmed.json: eleven minutes without activity -> real 409, challenge expired, created->idle exactly 600s, then the same confirmed factor reaches LoA2 on a fresh challenge
windows.absoluteExpiry: runs/absolute-expiry.json: real wall clock 948s; completing the password method at t+9min pushes the idle window forward 300s and clamps it to the absolute cap; absolute stays created+900s; the correct confirmed-factor code is refused with 409 at t+15.8min and the challenge is expired
windows.crossAccount: runs/cross-account-concurrency.json: a foreign identity gets 404 on another session's challenge; concurrent identical one-time codes yield exactly one LoA2; a consumed code replays to 409; a concurrent second password submission is refused with 409; another identity's recovery code returns verified=false
